task_message:
Case M32: segment the myxoid soft-tissue tumor on this T2-weighted MRI.

Volume: 240x240x442 voxels, 1 mm isotropic. Budgets: max 40 tool calls / 15 model prompts / 10 min wall time.
Start with `seg_open`. Finish with `seg_finish`.
final_assistant_text:
Case M32 complete.

**Result:** One myxoid soft-tissue tumor segmented in the left posterior thigh on the T2-weighted MRI.

- **Approach:** Scanned the volume with axial/coronal/sagittal sheets, found a large, very bright, well-circumscribed mass (~115 mm long) in the left thigh; seeded it with an interior point prompt, which produced a clean single-component mask (v1, 295 mL) matching the bright core.
- **Refinement:** Reviewed the poles (axial 277/284/395/398) and multiplanar borders; accepted intensity candidate C1, which added the thin hypointense rim/capsule and inferior lobulation (+66 mL, v2, 361 mL, 1 component). Rejected the large final-review candidates C1–C3 (normal surrounding fat/soft tissue).
- **Final mask:** v2, 361.4 mL, single component, extent axial 273–399, coronal 61–143, sagittal 25–101, boundary verified in all three planes.
- **Confidence:** high.
